intro: My academic journey in Computer Science spans from O'Levels through Intermediate to my ongoing BSCS at GU Tech. Along the way, I built a solid foundation starting with C in Matric, advancing to C++ during Intermediate, and independently exploring modern Python.

My overarching ambition is to evolve into a full-scale Solution Architect — bridging low-level computation, object-oriented software engineering, clean databases, and distributed system architectures.
